facts.business: Orient Green Power Company Limited is an Indian renewable energy-based power generation company focused on developing, owning, and operating wind and solar power plants.

segments.name: Generation and Sale of Power from Renewable Energy Sources (Wind & Solar)

capacity_or_capex.item: Wind Portfolio Expansion with 9.9 MW Larger Capacity Turbines
Repowering of 7.8 MW Old Wind Turbines

guidance_or_targets.statement: Investment plans for repowering and expansion expected to be completed in fiscal 2026-27 and to generate returns from next fiscal.

auditor.name: K. Rajagopal, B.Sc., FCA, ACS, Practicing Chartered Accountant
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: (i) Stay granted by Supreme Court on CERC order regarding REC floor price; Group confident of favourable decision on appeal for receivables of Rs 2,071 Lakhs as on March 31, 2017, with provision of Rs 1,580 Lakhs for expected credit losses till March 31, 2026. (ii) TNPDCL petitions before TNERC challenging CGP status of certain subsidiaries for earlier years claiming Cross Subsidy Surcharge; based on legal opinion and CGP compliance certificates, likelihood of liability is remote. Opinion not modified.

key_risks: Dependence on wind availability for generation
Regulatory risk regarding REC floor price reduction (CERC order stayed by Supreme Court)
Regulatory risk regarding Captive Generating Plant (CGP) status and Cross Subsidy Surcharge claims by TNPDCL
Interest rate risk on borrowings (fixed and floating)
Foreign currency exchange rate risk (Euro exposure)
